scope.objects: Five full benzyl-alcohol molecules, para H/Cl/Me/OMe/SMe, with neutral starting identities. Reaction-state choices belong to the investigation, with explicit atom/electron accounting.
scope.observed: Main p3 reports high or quantitative conversion for para OMe/Me/Cl and relatively low hydroxyl oxidation for para SMe in the preparative study. No common quantitative yield table is fabricated.
scope.conditions: Flavin-mediated visible-light electrophotochemical oxidation; main p2 Table1 analytical context uses 450 nm,25 C,argon,MeCN or9:1MeCN/water,0.3V applied vs Ag wire. These are context, not calculated electrode references or automatically the entire preparative protocol.
scope.question_boundary: Molecular origin and explanatory limits of the substituent dependence within the source oxidation problem.
scope.excluded: Full flavin/electrode/oxygen reaction networks, catalytic rates, yields or proof of a complete mechanism from isolated molecular descriptors.

scope.usable: The exact bound V1 report contains five gas electronic comparisons, mapped spin, curvature, finite gas conformers/common CPCM and a retrospective Cl cross-check. It establishes one feasible molecular route and supports auditing channel bookkeeping and numerical limitations.
scope.not_usable: No blind AR performance, no complete mechanism, activation barrier/yield prediction, global conformational guarantee, general functional error interval or acceptance of a different V2 route.

evidence.scope: Benchmark task design and claim-conditioned scientific standards; no new measurements or simulations.
